    • warnTopic

      public NtfyConfig.Builder warnTopic(String warnTopic)
      The topic WARN-level events are published to. Setting it to a non-blank value is the entire opt-in for WARN alerting — see NtfyConfig.isWarnRoutingEnabled(). null/blank (the default) keeps alerting ERROR-only.

    • actionsHeader

      public NtfyConfig.Builder actionsHeader(String actionsHeader)
      Sets action buttons from a raw, pre-formatted ntfy Actions header value (the short "simple" format, e.g. "view, View logs, https://grafana.example.com/d/abc"). Forwarded verbatim; null/blank sends no Actions header. This is the flat-string entry point used by environment/YAML/XML configuration.

    • actions

      public NtfyConfig.Builder actions(List<NtfyAction> actions)
      Sets action buttons from typed NtfyActions, serialized to the ntfy Actions header via NtfyActionSerializer. ntfy caps a notification at three actions; extra entries and null elements are dropped. A null/empty list sends no Actions header. Constructing an individual NtfyAction with a blank label/url throws.

    • excludedLoggerPrefixes

      Sets the excluded logger prefixes from an explicit list (defensively copied, null-safe).

    • excludedLoggers

      public NtfyConfig.Builder excludedLoggers(String csv)
      Convenience: sets the excluded logger prefixes from a single comma-separated string, trimming each entry and dropping blanks. A null/blank csv clears the list.

    • includeMdcKeys

      public NtfyConfig.Builder includeMdcKeys(List<String> keys)
      Sets the MDC-key allow-list from an explicit list (defensively copied, null-safe); a null list clears it. Order is preserved and is the order the entries are rendered in. See NtfyConfig.getIncludeMdcKeys() — there is no wildcard form on purpose.

    • includeMdcKeysCsv

      public NtfyConfig.Builder includeMdcKeysCsv(String csv)
      Convenience: sets the MDC-key allow-list from a single comma-separated string, trimming each entry and dropping blanks. A null/blank csv clears the list. This is the flat-string entry point used by environment/properties configuration.

      Deliberately a distinct method rather than a String/List overload pair (matching the existing excludedLoggerPrefixes/excludedLoggers(java.lang.String) precedent): an overload would make a bare null literal ambiguous at the call site.

      Limitation: an MDC key containing a comma is unreachable from any CSV surface — use includeMdcKeys(List) for that.

      Toggles asynchronous (offloaded) delivery of individual error alerts. On by default; set false for pre-2.0 synchronous delivery. See NtfyConfig.isAsyncEnabled().

      public NtfyConfig.Builder asyncQueueCapacity(int asyncQueueCapacity)

      Toggles refusing activation when credentials would traverse a cleartext http:// endpoint. On by default; set false for the pre-2.0 warn-and-activate behavior. See NtfyConfig.isRequireHttpsForCredentials().

    • startupPing

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPing(StartupPingMode startupPing)
      Selects the opt-in startup self-test mode (see NtfyConfig.getStartupPing()). A null argument resets to the StartupPingMode.OFF default.

    • startupPing

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPing(String startupPing)
      Convenience overload parsing a configured string (off/probe/publish, case-insensitive) so the XML and properties surfaces bind without carrying their own parser.

      A null/blank tag keeps the current value, and an UNRECOGNISED value keeps it too rather than throwing — the same lenient contract as locale(String) and the numeric setters, so one typo in a config file can never take down the host application. The engine warns about the typo at start (it can tell "unset" from "unparseable" because StartupPingMode.fromValue(java.lang.String) returns null only for the latter), and the caller may pre-check with fromValue when it wants to warn earlier.

    • startupPingFailFast

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPingFailFast(boolean startupPingFailFast)
      Toggles aborting application startup when the self-test fails; see NtfyConfig.isStartupPingFailFast(). Off by default, and also switches the self-test from background to inline execution when on.

    • startupPingWarn

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPingWarn(StartupPingMode startupPingWarn)
      Selects the startup self-test mode for the WARN route (see NtfyConfig.getStartupPingWarn()). A null argument resets to StartupPingMode.OFF.

    • startupPingWarn

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPingWarn(String startupPingWarn)
      Lenient string overload for startup-ping-warn; see startupPing(String).

    • startupPingNotifyFailures

      public NtfyConfig.Builder startupPingNotifyFailures(boolean startupPingNotifyFailures)
      Toggles announcing a failed self-test on a route that passed; see NtfyConfig.isStartupPingNotifyFailures(). On by default.

    • locale

      public NtfyConfig.Builder locale(Locale locale)
      Sets the language of notification bodies and diagnostics (see NtfyConfig.getLocale()). A null argument resets to the Locale.ENGLISH default.

    • locale

      public NtfyConfig.Builder locale(String languageTag)
      Convenience overload that parses a BCP 47 language tag (e.g. "fr", "de-DE") via Locale.forLanguageTag(String). A null/blank tag, or one whose language subtag is undetermined (garbage input, bare "und", "und-Latn", private-use "x-..." — all of which parse to an empty Locale.getLanguage()), keeps the Locale.ENGLISH default rather than silently selecting the undetermined locale.
